title: Emit and Verify
prompt: Configure a logger named 'app.checkpoint' with a StreamHandler writing to a StringIO and a formatter '%(levelname)s:%(name)s:%(message)s' (assign it to LOG_OUTPUT so the grader can read it). Then implement warn_twice(msg) that emits msg twice at WARNING level using lazy %-formatting.
boilerplate:
import io, logging

LOG_OUTPUT = io.StringIO()

log = logging.getLogger('app.checkpoint')
# configure handler + formatter here

def warn_twice(msg):
    pass

tests.name: warning appears with level and name
tests.code:
warn_twice('disk 80%')
out = LOG_OUTPUT.getvalue()
assert 'WARNING:app.checkpoint:disk 80%' in out
tests.hint: The formatter string decides the shape: LEVEL:NAME:MESSAGE.

tests.name: exactly two emissions
tests.hint: Call log.warning twice, not a loop of four.

tests.name: uses lazy formatting (no f-string in the call)
tests.code:
assert "f'" not in code and 'f"' not in code, 'pass values as logging args, not interpolated strings'
assert 'log.warning(' in code
